entries.title: Your phone's Approves secret uses switch turns off when your Mac stops it
entries.body: When your Mac stopped secret approvals from your iPhone or iPad together with another device's, the phone's switch in Settings → Devices could stay on until you opened Settings again. Now it turns off as soon as your Mac stops it.
entries.noPicture: The switch keeps its look; it now reads off when it should, which one picture cannot show.
